main.description: Get the private-tier posts the requester is authorized to read, authored by the requester or by accounts the requester follows, and the reposts of such posts by the requester or by accounts it follows that are community members (a followed account that is not a member gives no repost item), newest first. A repost item carries `reason` (app.bsky.feed.defs#reasonRepost) and sorts by the repost's time, ties broken by the repost's URI; a reposter the requester mutes, or with a block either way, gives none, and a repost of a post the requester may not read leaves no trace. The ordering field of a post's own item is its `record.createdAt` (descending, ties broken by post URI); a `createdAt` later than the time of indexing plus five minutes is clamped to that bound, and the view carries the clamped value. Requires auth by a ready community member. Posts the requester may not read are omitted without distinction, as are posts by accounts the requester mutes. Audiences this AppView resolves: `list` (the audience record's members); `followers` (followers of the audience's owner who are ready members of this AppView, by the follow records it has indexed, which reflect a new follow or an unfollow within about a minute); `everyone` (every ready member of this AppView, not the network); and `nobody`. `following`: the accounts the audience's owner follows that are ready members of this AppView, by the follow records it has indexed, once it has compared them with the owner's repository. Until then, and always for an owner that follows more than 50 000 accounts, a `following` audience is read by its owner alone, and replies under it by their authors alone. An unfollow stops reads within about a minute. A `following` post appears in a reader's timeline only when the reader also follows its owner. When neither the owner nor a replier is a ready member, and this AppView is not indexing public records, the owner's follow of the replier is not indexed, so that reply is read by its author alone. Any other mode is served to its author only. A block record or a private block between the reader and the author, or the audience's owner, in either direction, keeps the reader out; a block through a list does not. A reply is read by the readers of its thread root's current audience, or, in a private branch under a public post, of its branch root's current audience. It is served only when all of these hold: its root (or branch root) is stored, names an audience of its own author, and is visible; the reply names an audience of that author; its author, and the author of every post above it in its chain other than the root's author, may write under the root's current audience now, by the PDS's rule for that mode, and there is no block either way between them and the root's author; its chain of parents, through stored private posts agreeing on its root, reaches a post by the root's author (or the branch root) within 16 posts (this AppView's `max_chain`), each visible to the reader. The root author's own replies in a thread are not walked, and are read by the root's audience whatever audience they name. Replies deeper than the bound, or below someone who no longer stands under the current audience, are read only by their authors, except the root author's own thread replies. A post is never served to a reader where either has blocked the other. Its author always reads it, unless moderation hides it, even when the thread's owner has blocked the author or removed them from the audience. `audience` on the view is the governing audience.

cursor.description: Opaque, sealed pagination cursor from a previous response to the same requester. Any other cursor, including the unsealed createdAt::key form of earlier versions, is rejected with InvalidRequest; start the feed over.

feed.description: An item whose post is a reply carries reply, its root and parent (app.nearhorizon.private.defs#replyRef), while getMembership lists 'private.replyContext'. They are read after the page's items are chosen and do not count against the page's reads.

cursor.description: Present whenever more candidates remain. A page reads at most twice its `limit` in candidates. It can be short or empty and still carry a cursor; keep paging while a cursor is present. Absent at the end of the feed, and also, exceptionally, when the last examined position is too long to seal (an author whose did:web is several hundred characters), where the feed ends early.

degraded.description: Present and true while this AppView is degraded: a relay it reads private posts from is behind, so posts may be missing for now and should not be shown as deleted. Absent otherwise. The same for every requester at a given moment.

retryAfter.description: With degraded: seconds to wait before asking again (also sent as the Retry-After header).

unavailable.description: The requester's own private posts this response read and could not serve yet, each once; absent when none. Never names another account's post.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
